node: Coffee, tea, extract, beverage, and private-label supply for restaurants and foodservice
summary: Layer 1B expanded the underfollowed universe around B2B coffee, tea, extract, private-label beverage, route distribution, and beverage equipment exposure. The strongest public-company matches are not consumer coffee chains, but suppliers with foodservice/private-label/DSD/equipment hooks. Westrock Coffee is the cleanest small-cap public exposure to integrated coffee, tea, extract, RTD and foodservice beverage solutions. Farmer Brothers is a much smaller, distressed/speculative DSD coffee and equipment-service supplier. Coffee Holding is a micro-cap green-coffee/private-label/foodservice roaster that may be a second-order commodity and private-label beneficiary but needs customer verification. Middleby is not a coffee pure play, but its commercial foodservice equipment portfolio includes coffee and beverage dispensing assets, making it a mid-cap equipment/service-adjacent candidate. TreeHouse Foods would have been relevant historically for private-label coffee/tea, but it completed a take-private transaction in February 2026 and is excluded from the US-listed candidate list.
